title: Choose the SiteDatum commercial-site structure
question: All three preserve SiteDatum's existing identity and use real product evidence. Choose the composition that should lead C7.

options.label: The Field Desk
options.thesis: One working surface moves from today's pressure to the project record that resolves it.
options.viewport: A wide application capture sits beside one decisive statement, followed by a compact daily-loop rail.
options.risk: The interface evidence must remain legible without making the page feel like product documentation.

options.label: Command Center Proof
options.thesis: Lead with the real command center, then prove speed, ownership, and local control in that order.
options.viewport: The SiteDatum title and promise anchor a full-width overview capture with a restrained follow-development action.
options.risk: This is the clearest structure and therefore needs exceptionally disciplined typography to remain distinctive.

options.label: The Project Dossier
options.lineage: issued project record and transmittal cover
options.thesis: The site reads like a controlled project record: purpose, evidence, capabilities, terms, and issue status.
options.viewport: A precise title block frames the product statement and an inset screenshot as the first issued plate.
options.risk: Formal document structure can feel austere if the product capture does not carry enough energy.
